en: Several of the chapters gathered here I first drafted while staying in a village in southern Egypt. All of them I rewrote and completed in the same place. Occasionally the histories told by neighbors and friends in the village have made it into parts of the book. In two of the chapters I lay out in more detail some of the things I learned there.
zh: 本书收录的若干章节，最初是我在埃及南部一个村庄逗留时起草的。所有章节我都在同一个地方改写和完成。村里邻居和朋友讲述的历史，偶尔进入了本书的部分内容。在其中两章里，我更详细地阐述了自己在那里了解到的一些事情。

en: During more than a dozen stays over the past decade, for periods ranging from a few days to a few months, I incurred many unrepayable debts. Among the numerous people owed thanks, I want to mention Khairy Muhammad Ibrahim, his parents Muhammad and Fatna, and their family; Hamida bint al-Kumiya and her family; the households of the late Salim ʿAbd al-Warith, in particular Ahmad, Muhammad, Jamal, and their families, as well as the absent Sayyid for the use of his house; Hajj Lamiʿ Ahmad Muhammad and his family; Shahhat Shihittu; the family of Mahmud ʿAbdullahi; and Hasan Murad. I am grateful to all of them for their help and generosity.
zh: 过去十年间，我在那里逗留了十多次，短则数日，长则数月，欠下了许多无法偿还的人情。在众多应当感谢的人中，我想提到海伊里·穆罕默德·易卜拉欣、他的父母穆罕默德和法特娜及其家人；哈米达·宾特·库米娅及其家人；已故萨利姆·阿卜杜勒-瓦里斯一家，尤其是艾哈迈德、穆罕默德、贾迈勒及其家人，以及不在村的赛义德，感谢让我使用他的房子；哈吉·拉米阿·艾哈迈德·穆罕默德及其家人；沙哈特·希希图；马哈茂德·阿卜杜拉希的家人；以及哈桑·穆拉德。我感谢他们所有人的帮助和慷慨。

en: Two chapters of the book were published in full elsewhere and have been revised here only slightly. They speak the slightly different language of the time and place they first appeared. Read again in the surroundings of this book, I hope they can be interpreted in new ways. Chapter 5 was published as “The Representation of Rural Violence in Writings on Political Development,” in Peasants and Politics in the Modern History of the Middle East, edited by John Waterbury and Farhad Kazemi (University Presses of Florida, 1991), and chapter 7 appeared as “The Object of Development: America’s Egypt,” in Power of Development, edited by Jonathan Crush (Routledge, 1995). In addition, the first two-thirds of chapter 4 consist of a slightly revised version of “The Invention and Reinvention of the Egyptian Peasant,” International Journal of Middle East Studies 22: 129–50.
zh: 本书有两章曾全文发表于别处，此处只作了轻微修改。它们带有最初发表时当地和当时略有不同的语言。希望在这本书的语境中重读时，它们能得到新的解读。第5章曾以“The Representation of Rural Violence in Writings on Political Development”为题，发表于 John Waterbury 和 Farhad Kazemi 编的 Peasants and Politics in the Modern History of the Middle East（University Presses of Florida, 1991）；第7章曾以“The Object of Development: America’s Egypt”为题，发表于 Jonathan Crush 编的 Power of Development（Routledge, 1995）。此外，第4章的前三分之二是对“The Invention and Reinvention of the Egyptian Peasant”一文的轻微修订，该文发表于 International Journal of Middle East Studies 22: 129–50。

en: The final third of the chapter, however, presents new material that alters the significance of the part I previously published.
zh: 但该章最后三分之一呈现的新材料，改变了此前发表部分的意义。

en: Three other chapters draw on material published in partial or preliminary form elsewhere. Parts of chapter 6 are from a paper presented at the Sixth Biennial Conference of the International Association for the Study of Traditional Environments, “Manufacturing Heritage / Consuming Tradition,” Cairo, December 15, 1998, published in the proceedings of the conference, Consuming Tradition, Manufacturing Heritage: Global Norms and Urban Forms in the Age of Tourism, edited by Nezar AlSayyad (E. F. Spon, 2001). A preliminary version of chapter 8 was presented at a conference in Aswan in April 1997 and published in Cairo in Directions of Change in Rural Egypt, edited by Nicholas Hopkins and Kirsten Westergaard (American University in Cairo Press, 1998). The first half of chapter 9 was published in an earlier form as “No Factories, No Problems: The Logic of Neo-Liberalism in Egypt,” Review of African Political Economy, no. 82 (1999), 455–68. I am grateful to the editors of the publications just mentioned for their invitations to contribute my work, and for their many helpful suggestions for its improvement. I am also grateful to Cambridge University Press, Routledge, and E. F. Spon for permission to republish the earlier material.
zh: 另外三章也利用了部分或初步发表于别处的材料。第6章的部分内容来自提交给国际传统环境研究协会第六届双年会议“制造遗产／消费传统”的论文，该会议于1998年12月15日在开罗举行，论文发表于会议论文集 Consuming Tradition, Manufacturing Heritage: Global Norms and Urban Forms in the Age of Tourism，Nezar AlSayyad 编（E. F. Spon, 2001）。第8章的初稿曾在1997年4月阿斯旺的一次会议上宣读，并发表于开罗出版的 Directions of Change in Rural Egypt，Nicholas Hopkins 和 Kirsten Westergaard 编（American University in Cairo Press, 1998）。第9章的前半部分曾以较早的形式发表于“No Factories, No Problems: The Logic of Neo-Liberalism in Egypt,” Review of African Political Economy, no. 82 (1999), 455–68。我感谢上述出版物的编辑邀请我投稿，以及他们为改进稿件提出的许多有益建议。我也感谢 Cambridge University Press、Routledge 和 E. F. Spon 允许我重新发表先前的材料。

en: My research in Cairo in 1996–97 was supported by a fellowship from the American Research Center in Egypt, funded by the National Endowment for the Humanities. The directors and staff of the center, especially Amir and Amira Khattab, helped in numerous ways. A fellowship from the International Center for Advanced Study at New York University in 1999 gave me the opportunity to make progress on the writing.
zh: 我1996—97年在开罗的研究，由美国埃及研究中心提供、美国国家人文基金会资助的奖学金支持。该中心的主任和工作人员，尤其是阿米尔和阿米拉·哈塔卜，以多种方式提供了帮助。1999年纽约大学国际高级研究中心的奖学金，让我有机会推进写作。

en: In Egypt, a number of friends and colleagues offered intellectual support, hospitality, criticism, and opportunities to present my work in seminars and publish it in Arabic. I want to thank Mahmud Abdel-Fadil, Elwi Captan, Rania Fahmy, Ferial Ghazoul, Muhammad Hakim, Nawal Hassan, Ali Eddin Hilal, Siona Jenkins, Dalila al-Kirdani, Reem Saad, Mustafa Kamal al-Sayyid, Olivier Sednaoui, Hilmi Shaʿrawi, David Sims, and Soraya al-Torki. I owe special thanks to Bashir al-Sibaʿi, poet, historian, and extraordinary translator.
zh: 在埃及，许多朋友和同事提供了知识上的支持、款待、批评，以及让我在研讨会上展示工作并以阿拉伯语发表的机会。我要感谢马哈茂德·阿卜杜勒-法迪勒、埃尔维·卡普坦、拉尼娅·法赫米、费里亚尔·加祖勒、穆罕默德·哈基姆、纳瓦尔·哈桑、阿里丁·希拉勒、西奥娜·詹金斯、达利拉·基尔达尼、里姆·萨阿德、穆斯塔法·卡迈勒·赛义德、奥利维耶·塞德纳维、希勒米·沙拉维、大卫·西姆斯和索拉娅·托尔基。我特别感谢巴希尔·西巴伊——诗人、历史学家和杰出的翻译家。

en: It would be impossible to list all those from whose advice and criticism I benefited at meetings where I have presented my work over the last few years, or at N.Y.U. Among the many who have helped are Muhammed Hamdouni Alami, Nezar AlSayyad, Sophia Anninos, Arjun Appadurai, Talal Asad, Joel Beinin, Jennifer Bell, Tom Bender, Ethel Brooks, Nathan Brown, Terry Burke, Ray Bush, Koray Çalışkan, Dipesh Chakrabarty, Partha Chatterjee, Ken Cuno, Veena Das, Nick Dirks, Samera Esmair, Khaled Fahmy, Munir Fakhr al-Din, Jim Ferguson, Leela Fernandez, Robert Fernea, Michael Gilsenan, Peter Gran, Christine Harrington, Nicholas Hopkins, Huri Islamoglu, Wilson Jacob, Deniz Kandiyoti, Zachary Lockman, David Ludden, Kristine McNeil, Uday Mehta, Leila Mustafa, Fred Myers, Roger Owen, Stefania Pandolfo, Karen Pfeifer, James Piscatori, Panayiota Pyla, Gyan Prakash, Marsha Pripstein-Posusney, Anupama Rao, Vyjayanthi Rao, Yahya Sadowski, Omnia el-Shakry, Caroline Simpson, Susan Slyomovics, Kees van der Spek, Nancy Leys Stepan, Joe Stork, Sandra Sufian, James Toth, Robert Vitalis, and Jessica Winegar.
zh: 过去几年里，我曾在各种会议上以及纽约大学展示自己的工作，从中获益于许多人的建议和批评，无法一一列举。帮助过我的人中有穆罕默德·哈姆杜尼·阿拉米、内扎尔·赛义德、索菲娅·安尼诺斯、阿尔君·阿帕杜莱、塔拉勒·阿萨德、乔尔·贝宁、珍妮弗·贝尔、汤姆·本德、埃塞尔·布鲁克斯、内森·布朗、特里·伯克、雷·布什、科拉伊·恰勒什坎、迪佩什·查克拉巴蒂、帕尔塔·查特吉、肯·库诺、维娜·达斯、尼克·德克斯、萨梅拉·埃斯迈尔、哈立德·法赫米、穆尼尔·法赫尔丁、吉姆·弗格森、莉拉·费尔南德斯、罗伯特·费尼、迈克尔·吉尔西南、彼得·格兰、克里斯汀·哈林顿、尼古拉斯·霍普金斯、胡里·伊斯拉莫格卢、威尔逊·雅各布、德尼兹·坎迪约蒂、扎卡里·洛克曼、大卫·卢登、克里斯汀·麦克尼尔、乌代·梅塔、莱拉·穆斯塔法、弗雷德·迈尔斯、罗杰·欧文、斯特凡尼娅·潘多尔福、卡伦·法伊弗、詹姆斯·皮斯卡托里、帕纳约塔·皮拉、吉安·普拉卡什、玛莎·普里普斯坦-波苏斯尼、阿努帕玛·拉奥、维贾扬蒂·拉奥、叶海亚·萨多夫斯基、奥姆尼亚·沙克里、卡罗琳·辛普森、苏珊·斯利奥莫维奇、凯斯·范德施佩克、南希·莱斯·斯特潘、乔·斯托克、桑德拉·苏菲安、詹姆斯·托特、罗伯特·维塔利斯和杰西卡·温加。

en: None of those mentioned here is responsible for the views the book expresses or for whatever errors or oversights it contains.
zh: 此处提到的所有人都不对本书表达的观点或书中可能包含的任何错误或疏漏负责。

en: Lynne Withey, associate director of the University of California Press, waited patiently for this manuscript and then steered it expertly through review and publication. I also want to thank Mary Francis, Cindy Fulton, Marielle León, and Sharron Wood.
zh: 加州大学出版社副社长琳恩·威西耐心等候这份书稿，随后以其专业能力引导它通过评审和出版。我也要感谢玛丽·弗朗西斯、辛迪·富尔顿、马里埃尔·莱昂和沙龙·伍德。

en: Dr. Boutros Wadieh holds a special place among these expressions of gratitude. No one I know combines his breadth of knowledge of Egyptian and Arab history with such sympathy for the demands of ordinary lives. Several chapters of this book have benefited from his insights on almost every page. Janet Lippman Abu-Lughod and the late Ibrahim Abu-Lughod have given not only intellectual and moral support over the years but the example of their own political and intellectual commitment. The members of my own wider family in England have been an unfailing support. Adrian and Justine have lived their whole lives with this book, becoming Idris and Yasmin in the village and enduring many other abrupt changes in their circumstances with great spirit and understanding. Lila Abu-Lughod knows herself how much I have relied on her.
zh: 在这些感谢中，布特罗斯·瓦迪耶博士占有特殊位置。在我认识的人中，没有人像他那样，把对埃及史和阿拉伯史的广博知识与对普通人生活需求的深切同情结合在一起。本书若干章节几乎每一页都受益于他的洞见。珍妮特·利普曼·阿布-卢戈德和已故的易卜拉欣·阿布-卢戈德多年来不仅给予知识和道义上的支持，还以他们自己的政治和知识承诺作出榜样。我在英国更广大家庭的成员始终是我的支持。阿德里安和贾斯廷从小就与这本书相伴，在村里成了伊德里斯和亚斯敏，并以极大的勇气和理解力承受了境遇的许多其他骤然变化。莉拉·阿布-卢戈德自己知道我对她的依赖有多深。

纳吉阿·哈吉尔，埃及
2001年4月
